channel.title: Spring '26 Week 9 :: CC 410 Textbook
channel.description: Resources Slides Edited Transcript Hello and welcome to the week nine announcements video for CC Port 10 in spring 2026. So this week we’re going to do a couple of different things. We’re going to do a quick example on parallel programming. We’re also going to do an example on event-driven programming. These are kind of related topics of how we can actually run different code in different threads. Both of these examples are pretty small and just give you an idea of some of these topics that we haven’t touched on yet. And then you’ll be working on the seventh restaurant milestone where you’ll add some interactivity to your project.
